lines.speaker: A
lines.english: What time do you wake up every day?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Wǒ qī diǎn qǐchuáng, xiān hē shuǐ.
lines.english: I wake up at 7, drink water first.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: What do you eat for breakfast?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 吃面包，喝牛奶。七点半上班。
lines.pinyin: Chī miànbāo, hē niúnǎi. Qī diǎn bàn shàngbān.
lines.english: Eat bread, drink milk. Start work at 7:30.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Do you eat lunch at the company?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 是的，十二点吃米饭。下午休息一点。
lines.pinyin: Shì de, shí'èr diǎn chī mǐfàn. Xiàwǔ xiūxi yīdiǎn.
lines.english: Yes, eat rice at 12. Rest a bit in the afternoon.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Jǐ diǎn xiàbān? Wǎnshàng zuò shénme?
lines.english: What time off work? What do you do in the evening?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 六点下班。回家做饭，看书，十点睡觉。
lines.pinyin: Liù diǎn xiàbān. Huíjiā zuòfàn, kànshū, shí diǎn shuìjiào.
lines.english: Off at 6. Go home cook, read, sleep at 10.
